full_name: Casey G. Rothschild | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Wellesley College
bio: Casey G. Rothschild is an associate professor of economics at Wellesley College. His research focuses on the optimal design of tax systems and on the impact of regulatory interventions in insurance markets.
